rubrics.justification: The response failed to use the provided Gardner score (3AB) and incorrectly stated no Gardner score was available, so it did not assess the known morphology.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior outcomes, sperm data, endometrium, and lifestyle factors reasonably well with prognosis, though some links are overstated.
Overall structure is logical, but it is undermined by the major omission of the provided embryo grade and by somewhat speculative penalty adjustments for smoking, stress, and BMI.
Many recommendations are broadly evidence-based, but PGT-A and ERA are suggested too readily for this profile, and some claims about smoking/stress effects are stronger than guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical steps for transfer support, smoking cessation, weight optimization, and future testing, though some recommendations are not ideally prioritized for this exact case.
